title: The Sensor That Never Touched the Screen: A Thread of Its Own, One Way Across and a Stop That Joins
fallback: This lesson puts a Qt thread, a queued update and an event loop together, so it needs Qt. Lesson 07-16 is the same rig in plain C++: a producer, a consumer, a stop token and a joined pair of threads, measured. Without Qt, do that and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a sensor on a thread of its own that reaches the interface only through a latest value, and whose stop joins the thread
